prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. THREE rows. TOP KAINO older male cooper master, greying beard, dull russet tunic and dark leather apron, small wooden mallet lowered safely. MIDDLE BELO adult male cooper apprentice distinct from brewer TIO, black cropped hair, faded slate tunic, short tan apron, holding one small closed wooden barrel hoop with no dangerous load. BOTTOM FULEN adult female container purchaser for one ordinary care shift, brown hair under cream kerchief, moss dress, brown shoulder shawl, holding a small EMPTY plain wooden pail. No barrel allocation, shared seal, healing claim or apprenticeship outcome.
